collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager shows off a new canoe in the lagoon as it slowly sinks: keep smiling, or abandon ship.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has finished a new little canoe, and now sits in it proudly in the shallow, knee-deep part of the lagoon, for everyone to admire. As the village gathers on the shore, it slowly becomes clear that the canoe is sinking. Very, very slowly. Water is seeping in through one seam, and (subject), sitting bolt upright with (subject.his/her) paddle, is going down at about the speed of a snail.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) keeps smiling and waving as the water rises past (subject.his/her) waist. The canoe settles gently on the sandy bottom, with (subject) still sitting perfectly upright in it. "It floats," (subject.he/she) announces, "just not for long." The crowd cheers wildly. (friend) helps (subject.him/her) fix the seam the next day.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) leaps out with a great splash and drags the canoe ashore, where (friend) helps (subject.him/her) find the leak and seal it with tree gum. The second launch is perfect: the canoe floats beautifully. The crowd, which came back hoping for more sinking, is a little disappointed.
